name: BC subreport 2013
rs: SELECT T.IdLista, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA, Sum(T.Cant) AS CantT, Sum([cant])*[putva] AS Valoare FROM Produse INNER JOIN ((SELECT LegBCLA.IdLista, Iesiri.IdProdus, Iesiri.Cant FROM (LegBCLA INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON LegBCLA.IdBonConsum = Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum) INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum WHERE LegBCLA.IdLista=[Forms]![ListaAlimente]![IDLISTA] UNION ALL SELECT LegBCLA.IdLista, Iesiri.IdProdus, -1*[Cant] AS Expr1 FROM LegBCLA INNER JOIN (Iesiri_H INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) ON LegBCLA.IdBonConsum = Iesiri_H.IdRetur WHERE LegBCLA.IdLista=[Forms]![ListaAlimente]![IDLISTA]) AS T INNER JOIN ProduseP ON T.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID GROUP BY T.IdLista, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA;

name: BonRetur
rs: SELECT Day([iesiri_H].[databc]) AS Ziua, Month([iesiri_H].[databc]) AS Luna, Year([iesiri_H].[databc]) AS Anul, Iesiri_H.NumarBC AS NrFact, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Sum(IesiriRetur.Cant) AS Cant, Produse.UM, Round([produsep]![PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]) AS Pret, Sum(Round([iesiriretur].[cant]*[produsep]![putva],[tempvars]![zec])) AS Valoare, Clienti.Denumire AS cDenumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Iesiri_H_1.NumarBC AS BCOLD FROM (((Clienti INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON Clienti.IDC = Iesiri_H.IDC) INNER JOIN IesiriRetur ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = IesiriRetur.IdBonConsum) INNER JOIN ((Masini INNER JOIN Produse ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) ON IesiriRetur.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) INNER JOIN Iesiri_H AS Iesiri_H_1 ON Iesiri_H.IdRetur = Iesiri_H_1.IdBonConsum WHERE (((Iesiri_H.idbonconsum)=[forms]![br]![IdBonConsum])) GROUP BY Day([iesiri_H].[databc]), Month([iesiri_H].[databc]), Year([iesiri_H].[databc]), Iesiri_H.NumarBC, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, Round([produsep]![PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]), Clienti.Denumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Iesiri_H_1.NumarBC;

name: Bon_Consum
rs: SELECT Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum, Masini.Masina, Clienti.Denumire AS Client, Iesiri_H.NumarBC AS NrFact, Iesiri_H.DataBC, Day([databc]) AS Ziua, Month([databc]) AS Luna, Year([databc]) AS Anul, Iesiri_H.ValoareBC, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, Iesiri.Cant, Iesiri.PUTVA AS Pret, Iesiri.ValoareCUTVA AS Valoare, Iesiri_H.Expl FROM ((Masini INNER JOIN Produse ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina) INNER JOIN (((Clienti INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON Clienti.IDC = Iesiri_H.IDC) INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Iesiri.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON (tmpSFP.CodProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) AND (Iesiri.IdBonConsum = tmpSFP.IdBonConsum) WHERE (((Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum) In (select IdBonConsum FROM [tmpSFP] WHERE S=True GROUP BY IdBonConsum)) AND ((Iesiri_H.DataBC) Between [forms]![SFP]![di] And [Forms]![SFP]![dsf]) AND ((tmpSFP.S)=True)) ORDER BY Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum, Produse.DenumireP;

name: BUConsum
rs: SELECT Day([databc]) AS Ziua, Month([databc]) AS Luna, Year([databc]) AS Anul, Iesiri_H.NumarBC AS NrFact, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS Cant, Produse.UM, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS SumOfCant, Round([produsep]![PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]) AS Pret, Sum(Round([Iesiri]![cant]*[produsep]![putva],[tempvars]![zec])) AS Valoare, Clienti.Denumire AS cDenumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina FROM (Masini INNER JOIN Produse ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina) INNER JOIN (((Clienti INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON Clienti.IDC = Iesiri_H.IDC) INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Iesiri.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID WHERE (((Iesiri_H.idbonconsum)=[forms]![bc]![IdBonConsum])) GROUP BY Day([databc]), Month([databc]), Year([databc]), Iesiri_H.NumarBC, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, Round([produsep]![PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]), Clienti.Denumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina;

name: BUConsum_F
rs: SELECT Day([databc]) AS Ziua, Month([databc]) AS Luna, Year([databc]) AS Anul, Iesiri_H.NumarBC AS NrFact, Iesiri.Denumire, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS Cant, Iesiri.CodProdus, Iesiri.UM, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS SumOfCant, Round([PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]) AS Pret, Sum(Round([Iesiri]![cant]*[putva],[tempvars]![zec])) AS Valoare, Clienti.Denumire AS cDenumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Furnizori.Denumire AS Furnizor FROM (Masini INNER JOIN ((Clienti INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON Clienti.IDC = Iesiri_H.IDC) INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) ON Masini.IdMasina = Iesiri_H.IdMasina) INNER JOIN Furnizori ON Iesiri.IDF = Furnizori.IDF WHERE (((Iesiri_H.idbonconsum)=[forms]![bc]![IdBonConsum])) GROUP BY Day([databc]), Month([databc]), Year([databc]), Iesiri_H.NumarBC, Iesiri.Denumire, Iesiri.CodProdus, Iesiri.UM, Round([PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]), Clienti.Denumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Furnizori.Denumire;

name: BUConsum_F1
rs: SELECT Iesiri_H.DataBC, Day([databc]) AS Ziua, Month([databc]) AS Luna, Year([databc]) AS Anul, Iesiri_H.NumarBC AS NrFact, Iesiri.Denumire, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS Cant, Iesiri.CodProdus, Iesiri.UM, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS SumOfCant, Round([PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]) AS Pret, Sum(Round([Iesiri]![cant]*[putva],[tempvars]![zec])) AS Valoare, Clienti.Denumire AS cDenumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Furnizori.Denumire AS Furnizor FROM Masini INNER JOIN ((Clienti INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON Clienti.IDC = Iesiri_H.IDC) INNER JOIN (Iesiri INNER JOIN Furnizori ON Iesiri.IDF = Furnizori.IDF) ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) ON Masini.IdMasina = Iesiri_H.IdMasina WHERE (((Iesiri_H.idbonconsum)=[forms]![bc]![IdBonConsum])) GROUP BY Iesiri_H.DataBC, Day([databc]), Month([databc]), Year([databc]), Iesiri_H.NumarBC, Iesiri.Denumire, Iesiri.CodProdus, Iesiri.UM, Round([PUTVA],[tempvars]![zec]), Clienti.Denumire, Iesiri_H.Expl, Masini.Masina, Furnizori.Denumire;

rs: SELECT X.IdMasina, X.Masina, X.CodProdus, X.Denumire, X.UM, X.Cant, X.PUTVA, [Cant]*[putva] AS Valoare FROM (SELECT Masini.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, ProduseP.IdProdus AS Codprodus, Produse.denumirep AS Denumire, Produse.UM, Sum(Iesiri.Cant) AS Cant, Iesiri.PUTVA FROM ((Masini INNER JOIN Produse ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina) INNER JOIN (((Clienti INNER JOIN Iesiri_H ON Clienti.IDC = Iesiri_H.IDC) INNER JOIN Iesiri ON Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = Iesiri.IdBonConsum) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Iesiri.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON (Iesiri.IdProdus = tmpSFP.CodProdus) AND (Iesiri_H.IdBonConsum = tmpSFP.IdBonConsum) WHERE (((Iesiri_H.DataBC) Between [Forms]![SFP]![di] And [Forms]![SFP]![dsf]) AND ((tmpSFP.S)=True)) GROUP BY Masini.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.denumirep, Produse.UM, Iesiri.PUTVA ORDER BY Produse.denumirep) AS X ORDER BY X.Denumire;

rs: SELECT X.IDFM, X.IDF, X.CODP, X.ID, X.Numar, X.CIN, X.CIE, X.CR, X.Data, X.IdIntrareIesire FROM (SELECT FM_2.IDFM, FM_2.CODP, FM_2.ID, FM_2.Numar, FM_2.CIN, FM_2.CIE, FM_2.CR, FM_2.Data, FM_2.IDF, FM_2.IdIntrareIesire FROM FM_2 GROUP BY FM_2.IDFM, FM_2.CODP, FM_2.ID, FM_2.Numar, FM_2.CIN, FM_2.CIE, FM_2.CR, FM_2.Data, FM_2.IDF, FM_2.IdIntrareIesire HAVING (((FM_2.Data) Between [forms]![sfp]![di] And [forms]![sfp]![dsf])) UNION ALL SELECT -1, FM_2.CODP, -2 AS Expr1, "Stoc final" AS Expr2, Sum(FM_2.CIN) AS SumOfCIN, Sum(FM_2.CIE) AS SumOfCIE, Sum([cin])-Sum([cie]) AS CRR, Datevalue([forms]![sfp]![di])-1 AS Expr3, FM_2.IDF,0 FROM FM_2 WHERE (((FM_2.Data)<[forms]![sfp]![di])) GROUP BY FM_2.CODP, -2, "Stoc final", [forms]![sfp]![di], FM_2.IDF) AS X ORDER BY X.IDF, X.CODP, X.Data, X.IdIntrareIesire, X.ID;

rs: SELECT X.IdMasina, X.IDC, X.Masina, X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.CodProdus, X.DENP, X.UMP, X.PT, Sum([CI]+[CCIn]-[CCOut]) AS CF, Sum([vi]+[vcin]-[vcout]) AS VF, ProduseP.COD, Produse.CC FROM (SELECT Clienti.Adresa,OI_Union.IDC, Clienti.Denumire, OI_Union.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, OI_Union.CodProdus, OI_Union.DenumireProdus AS DENP, Nz([UM],"Buc") AS UMP, OI_Union.PUTVA AS PT, Sum(OI_Union.C0) AS CI, Sum(OI_Union.V0) AS VI, Sum(OI_Union.C1) AS CCIn, Sum(OI_Union.V1) AS VCIn, Sum(OI_Union.V2) AS CCOut, Sum(OI_Union.C2) AS VCOut FROM (OI_Union INNER JOIN Masini ON OI_Union.IdMasina = Masini.IdMasina) INNER JOIN Clienti ON OI_Union.IDC = Clienti.IDC GROUP BY Clienti.Adresa,OI_Union.IDC, Clienti.Denumire, OI_Union.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, OI_Union.CodProdus, OI_Union.DenumireProdus, Nz([UM],"Buc"), OI_Union.PUTVA HAVING (((OI_Union.IDC) In (select IDC from [tmpSFP] where s=true group by idc))) ORDER BY OI_Union.DenumireProdus) AS X INNER JOIN (ProduseP INNER JOIN Produse ON ProduseP.ID = Produse.ID) ON X.CodProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus GROUP BY X.IdMasina, X.IDC, X.Masina, X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.CodProdus, X.DENP, X.UMP, X.PT, ProduseP.COD, Produse.CC HAVING (((X.CodProdus) In (SELECT Codprodus from [tmpSFP] WHERE S=TRue)) AND ((Sum([CI]+[CCIn]-[CCOut]))<>0)) ORDER BY X.DENP;

name: NIR

rs: SELECT Furnizori.Denumire, Furnizori.Adresa, Furnizori.CF, Furnizori.J, Masini.Masina, NIR.NrFact, NIR.DataFc, NIR.Numar, NIR.Data, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA, Intrari.ID AS Ordine, Intrari.Cant, Intrari.Pret, Intrari.TVA, Intrari.Valoare, Intrari.ValoareCUTVA, ComisieNIR.Receptie1, ComisieNIR.Receptie2, ComisieNIR.Receptie3, ComisieNIR.Receptie4, ProduseP.COD FROM (((Produse INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN ((Furnizori INNER JOIN NIR ON Furnizori.IDF = NIR.IDF) INNER JOIN Intrari ON NIR.IdIntrare = Intrari.IdIntrare) ON ProduseP.IdProdus = Intrari.IdProdus) INNER JOIN Masini ON NIR.IdMasina = Masini.IdMasina) INNER JOIN ComisieNIR ON NIR.IdComisie = ComisieNIR.IdComisie WHERE (((NIR.IdIntrare) Like [Forms]![FC]![IdIntrare]));

name: NIR_SFP
caption: Nota de receptie si constatare diferente
rs: SELECT Furnizori.Denumire, Furnizori.Adresa, Furnizori.CF, Furnizori.J, Masini.Masina, NIR.NrFact, NIR.DataFc, NIR.Numar, NIR.Data, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA, Intrari.ID AS Ordine, Intrari.Cant, Intrari.Pret, Intrari.TVA, Intrari.Valoare, Intrari.ValoareCUTVA, ComisieNIR.Receptie1, ComisieNIR.Receptie2, ComisieNIR.Receptie3, ComisieNIR.Receptie4 FROM Masini INNER JOIN ((((Produse INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN ((Furnizori INNER JOIN NIR ON Furnizori.IDF = NIR.IDF) INNER JOIN Intrari ON NIR.IdIntrare = Intrari.IdIntrare) ON ProduseP.IdProdus = Intrari.IdProdus) INNER JOIN ComisieNIR ON NIR.IdComisie = ComisieNIR.IdComisie) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON (tmpSFP.CodProdus = Intrari.IdProdus) AND (NIR.IdIntrare = tmpSFP.IdIntrare)) ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina WHERE (((tmpSFP.S)=True));

name: NIR_Storno
caption: Nota de receptie si constatare diferente
rs: SELECT Masini.Masina, Furnizori.Denumire, Furnizori.Adresa, Furnizori.CF, NIR.NrFact, NIR.DataFc, NIR.Numar, NIR.Data, ProduseP.IdProdus, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA, -1*[cant] AS CantR, -1*Round([produsep]![putva]*[intraristorno]![cant],[tempvars]![zec]) AS ValoareCT, ComisieNIR.Receptie1, ComisieNIR.Receptie2, ComisieNIR.Receptie3, ComisieNIR.Receptie4 FROM (((Masini INNER JOIN Produse ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina) INNER JOIN (ProduseP INNER JOIN (NIR INNER JOIN IntrariStorno ON NIR.IdIntrare = IntrariStorno.IdIntrare) ON ProduseP.IdProdus = IntrariStorno.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN ComisieNIR ON NIR.IdComisie = ComisieNIR.IdComisie) INNER JOIN Furnizori ON NIR.IDF = Furnizori.IDF;

name: Nota_Comanda
rs: SELECT Furnizori.Denumire, NIR.DataFc, Produse.denumirep AS DenumireProdus, Produse.UM, Sum(Intrari.Cant) AS SumOfCant, Sum(Intrari.ValoareCUTVA) AS SumOfValoareCUTVA FROM (Produse INNER JOIN ((Furnizori INNER JOIN (NIR INNER JOIN Intrari ON NIR.IdIntrare = Intrari.IdIntrare) ON Furnizori.IDF = NIR.IDF) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Intrari.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON ProduseP.IdProdus = tmpSFP.CodProdus WHERE (((NIR.Data) Between [forms]![sfp]![di] And [forms]![sfp]![dsf]) AND ((tmpSFP.S)=True) AND ((NIR.IdIntrare) In (SELECT IdIntrare FROM [tmpSFP] WHERE S=True GROUP BY IdIntrare))) GROUP BY Furnizori.Denumire, NIR.DataFc, Produse.denumirep, Produse.UM HAVING (((Sum(Intrari.ValoareCUTVA))>0)) ORDER BY Produse.denumirep;

name: OI_Fisa_Evidenta
rs: SELECT X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.Masina, OI_Evidenta.Numar, OI_Evidenta.Data, X.CodProdus, X.DenumireProdus, X.UM, X.PUTVA, X.CF, X.VF FROM (SELECT OI_Evidenta.IDC, Min(IIf(Left([numar],2)="BP" Or "BT",[ID],0)) AS IDX, OI_Evidenta.Masina, OI_Evidenta.Denumire, Clienti.Adresa, OI_Evidenta.CodProdus, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus, OI_Evidenta.UM, OI_Evidenta.PUTVA, Sum([c0]+[c1]-[c2]) AS CF, Sum([v0]+[v1]-[v2]) AS VF FROM OI_Evidenta INNER JOIN Clienti ON OI_Evidenta.IDC = Clienti.IDC GROUP BY OI_Evidenta.IDC, OI_Evidenta.Masina, OI_Evidenta.Denumire, Clienti.Adresa, OI_Evidenta.CodProdus, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus, OI_Evidenta.UM, OI_Evidenta.PUTVA HAVING (((OI_Evidenta.IDC) In (select idc from [tmpSFP] where s=true group by idc)) AND ((Sum([c0]+[c1]-[c2]))<>0)) ORDER BY OI_Evidenta.Masina, OI_Evidenta.Denumire, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus) AS X INNER JOIN OI_Evidenta ON (X.IDX = OI_Evidenta.ID) AND (X.CodProdus = OI_Evidenta.CodProdus) GROUP BY X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.Masina, OI_Evidenta.Numar, OI_Evidenta.Data, X.CodProdus, X.DenumireProdus, X.UM, X.PUTVA, X.CF, X.VF;

name: OI_Fisa_Evidenta_Primitori
rs: SELECT OI_Evidenta.IDC, OI_Evidenta.PUTVA, OI_Evidenta.Denumire, Clienti_1.Adresa, Nz([clienti]![Denumire],Switch(Left([numar],2)="BP","-",Left([numar],2)="BS","Casare")) AS Primitor, OI_Evidenta.Numar, OI_Evidenta.Data, OI_Evidenta.CodProdus, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus, OI_Evidenta.UM, Sum(OI_Evidenta.C0) AS C0, Sum(OI_Evidenta.V0) AS V0, Sum(OI_Evidenta.C1) AS C1, Sum(OI_Evidenta.V1) AS V1, Sum(OI_Evidenta.C2) AS C2, Sum(OI_Evidenta.V2) AS V2, OI_Evidenta.Tip, OI_Evidenta.Ord FROM ((OI_Evidenta LEFT JOIN OI_Transfer ON (OI_Evidenta.ID = OI_Transfer.IDBT) AND (OI_Evidenta.CodProdus = OI_Transfer.IdProdus) AND (OI_Evidenta.Numar = OI_Transfer.NRBT)) LEFT JOIN Clienti ON OI_Transfer.IDC_BT = Clienti.IDC) INNER JOIN Clienti AS Clienti_1 ON OI_Evidenta.IDC = Clienti_1.IDC GROUP BY OI_Evidenta.IDC, OI_Evidenta.PUTVA, OI_Evidenta.Denumire, Clienti_1.Adresa, Nz([clienti]![Denumire],Switch(Left([numar],2)="BP","-",Left([numar],2)="BS","Casare")), OI_Evidenta.Numar, OI_Evidenta.Data, OI_Evidenta.CodProdus, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus, OI_Evidenta.UM, OI_Evidenta.Tip, OI_Evidenta.Ord HAVING (((OI_Evidenta.IDC) In (select IDC FROM [tmpSFP] where s=true group by idc)) AND ((OI_Evidenta.Data)<=[Forms]![SFP]![dsf])) ORDER BY OI_Evidenta.Denumire, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus, OI_Evidenta.Tip, OI_Evidenta.Ord;

name: OI_Fisa_Evidenta_Primitori_STOC
rs: SELECT X.IDC, X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.CodProdus, X.DenumireProdus, X.UM, X.PUTVA, [c0]+[c1]-[c2] AS CF, [v0]+[v1]-[v2] AS VF FROM (SELECT OI_Evidenta.IDC, OI_Evidenta.Denumire, Clienti_1.Adresa, OI_Evidenta.CodProdus, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus, OI_Evidenta.UM, OI_Evidenta.PUTVA, Sum(OI_Evidenta.C0) AS C0, Sum(OI_Evidenta.V0) AS V0, Sum(OI_Evidenta.C1) AS C1, Sum(OI_Evidenta.V1) AS V1, Sum(OI_Evidenta.C2) AS C2, Sum(OI_Evidenta.V2) AS V2 FROM OI_Evidenta INNER JOIN Clienti AS Clienti_1 ON OI_Evidenta.IDC = Clienti_1.IDC WHERE (((OI_Evidenta.Data)<=[Forms]![SFP]![dsf])) GROUP BY OI_Evidenta.IDC, OI_Evidenta.Denumire, Clienti_1.Adresa, OI_Evidenta.CodProdus, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus, OI_Evidenta.UM, OI_Evidenta.PUTVA HAVING (((OI_Evidenta.IDC) In (select IDC FROM [tmpSFP] where s=true group by idc))) ORDER BY OI_Evidenta.Denumire, OI_Evidenta.DenumireProdus) AS X GROUP BY X.IDC, X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.CodProdus, X.DenumireProdus, X.UM, X.PUTVA, [c0]+[c1]-[c2], [v0]+[v1]-[v2] HAVING ((([c0]+[c1]-[c2])<>0));

name: OI_LISTA_INVENTAR
rs: SELECT X.IdMasina, X.IDC, X.Masina, X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.CodProdus, X.DENP, X.UMP, X.PT, Sum([CI]+[CCIn]-[CCOut]) AS CF, Sum([vi]+[vcin]-[vcout]) AS VF FROM (SELECT Clienti.Adresa,OI_Union.IDC, Clienti.Denumire, OI_Union.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, OI_Union.CodProdus, OI_Union.DenumireProdus AS DENP, Nz([UM],"Buc") AS UMP, OI_Union.PUTVA AS PT, Sum(OI_Union.C0) AS CI, Sum(OI_Union.V0) AS VI, Sum(OI_Union.C1) AS CCIn, Sum(OI_Union.V1) AS VCIn, Sum(OI_Union.V2) AS CCOut, Sum(OI_Union.C2) AS VCOut FROM (OI_Union INNER JOIN Masini ON OI_Union.IdMasina = Masini.IdMasina) INNER JOIN Clienti ON OI_Union.IDC = Clienti.IDC GROUP BY Clienti.Adresa,OI_Union.IDC, Clienti.Denumire, OI_Union.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, OI_Union.CodProdus, OI_Union.DenumireProdus, Nz([UM],"Buc"), OI_Union.PUTVA HAVING (((OI_Union.IDC) In (select IDC from [tmpSFP] where s=true group by idc))) ORDER BY OI_Union.DenumireProdus) AS X GROUP BY X.IdMasina, X.IDC, X.Masina, X.Denumire, X.Adresa, X.CodProdus, X.DENP, X.UMP, X.PT HAVING (((X.CodProdus) In (SELECT Codprodus from [tmpSFP] WHERE S=TRue)) AND ((Sum([CI]+[CCIn]-[CCOut]))<>0)) ORDER BY X.DENP;

name: OI_LISTA_INVENTAR_TOTAL
rs: SELECT X.IdMasina, X.Masina, X.CodProdus, X.DENP, X.UMP, X.PT, Sum([CI]+[CCIn]-[CCOut]) AS CF, Sum([vi]+[vcin]-[vcout]) AS VF FROM (SELECT OI_Union.IDC, Clienti.Denumire, OI_Union.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, OI_Union.CodProdus, OI_Union.DenumireProdus AS DENP, Nz([UM],"Buc") AS UMP, OI_Union.PUTVA AS PT, Sum(OI_Union.C0) AS CI, Sum(OI_Union.V0) AS VI, Sum(OI_Union.C1) AS CCIn, Sum(OI_Union.V1) AS VCIn, Sum(OI_Union.V2) AS CCOut, Sum(OI_Union.C2) AS VCOut FROM (OI_Union INNER JOIN Masini ON OI_Union.IdMasina = Masini.IdMasina) INNER JOIN Clienti ON OI_Union.IDC = Clienti.IDC GROUP BY OI_Union.IDC, Clienti.Denumire, OI_Union.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, OI_Union.CodProdus, OI_Union.DenumireProdus, Nz([UM],"Buc"), OI_Union.PUTVA HAVING (((OI_Union.IDC) In (select IDC from [tmpSFP] where s=true group by idc))) ORDER BY OI_Union.DenumireProdus) AS X GROUP BY X.IdMasina, X.Masina, X.CodProdus, X.DENP, X.UMP, X.PT HAVING (((Sum([CI]+[CCIn]-[CCOut]))<>0)) ORDER BY X.DENP;

name: OI_Predare
rs: SELECT OI_Predare.IDBP, OI_Predare.IDC_BP, OI_Predare.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, Clienti.Denumire, OI_Predare.NRBP, OI_Predare.DATABP, OI_Predare.idprodus AS CodProdus, Produse.denumirep AS DenumireProdus, Produse.UM, OI_Predare.Cant, OI_Predare.PUTVA, OI_Predare.ValoareCUTVA, OI_Predare.Expl FROM Produse INNER JOIN ((Clienti INNER JOIN (Masini INNER JOIN OI_Predare ON Masini.IdMasina = OI_Predare.IdMasina) ON Clienti.IDC = OI_Predare.IDC_BP) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON OI_Predare.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID WHERE (((OI_Predare.IDBP) Like [forms]![OI_Predare]![IDBP]));

name: OI_Transfer
rs: SELECT OI_Transfer.IDBT, OI_Transfer.IDC_BT, OI_Transfer.IDC_OLD, OI_Transfer.IdMasina, Masini.Masina, C1.Denumire AS Primitor, C2.Denumire AS Predator, OI_Transfer.NRBT, OI_Transfer.DATABT, OI_Transfer.idprodus AS CodProdus, Produse.denumirep AS DenumireProdus, Produse.UM, OI_Transfer.Cant, OI_Transfer.PUTVA, OI_Transfer.ValoareCUTVA, OI_Transfer.Expl FROM Produse INNER JOIN ((Masini INNER JOIN (Clienti AS C2 INNER JOIN (Clienti AS C1 INNER JOIN OI_Transfer ON C1.IDC = OI_Transfer.IDC_BT) ON C2.IDC = OI_Transfer.IDC_OLD) ON Masini.IdMasina = OI_Transfer.IdMasina) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON OI_Transfer.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID WHERE (((OI_Transfer.IDBT) Like [forms]![OI_Transfer]![IDBt]));

name: Plan_Achizitii
caption: Plan anual de achiziții
rs: SELECT Masini.Masina, Masini.IdMasina, Produse.CPV, Nz([RO],[denumirep]) AS Denumireprodus, Sum(Intrari.Cant) AS Cant, Sum(Intrari.ValoareCUTVA) AS ValoareCUTVA FROM (((Masini INNER JOIN Produse ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina) INNER JOIN (Intrari INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Intrari.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON Intrari.IdProdus = tmpSFP.CodProdus) LEFT JOIN cpv ON Produse.CPV = cpv.CODE WHERE (((tmpSFP.S)=True)) GROUP BY Masini.Masina, Masini.IdMasina, Produse.CPV, Nz([RO],[denumirep]) ORDER BY Nz([RO],[denumirep]);

name: Referat_periodic_Intrari
rs: SELECT T.IdProdus, T.Denumire, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, T.SumOfCant AS Cant, ProduseP.PUTVA, Sum([sumofcant])*[putva] AS ValoareCUTVA FROM Produse INNER JOIN ((SELECT ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire, Sum(Intrari.Cant) as SumOfCant FROM Produse INNER JOIN (ProduseP INNER JOIN ((Furnizori INNER JOIN NIR ON Furnizori.IDF = NIR.IDF) INNER JOIN Intrari ON NIR.IdIntrare = Intrari.IdIntrare) ON ProduseP.IdProdus = Intrari.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID WHERE ProduseP.IdProdus In (SELECT Codprodus FROM tmpSFP WHERE S=TRUE) AND NIR.Data Between [forms]![sfp]![di] And [forms]![sfp]![dsf] AND Nir.NrFact IN (SELECT NrFact FROM tmpSFP WHERE S=True) GROUP BY ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire UNION ALL SELECT ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire, -1* Sum(IntrariStorno.Cant) AS SumOfCant FROM (Produse INNER JOIN ((Furnizori INNER JOIN (NIR INNER JOIN IntrariStorno ON NIR.IdIntrare = IntrariStorno.IdIntrare) ON Furnizori.IDF = NIR.IDF) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON IntrariStorno.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON ProduseP.IdProdus = tmpSFP.CodProdus WHERE NIR.Data Between [forms]![sfp]![di] And [forms]![sfp]![dsf] AND tmpSFP.S =True GROUP BY ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire) AS T INNER JOIN ProduseP ON T.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID GROUP BY T.IdProdus, T.Denumire, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, T.SumOfCant, ProduseP.PUTVA HAVING (((T.SumOfCant)<>0));

name: Referat_periodic_produs
rs: SELECT X.Denumire, X.DenumireP, X.UM, Sum(X.scant) AS Cant, Sum([scant]*[putva]) AS ValoareCUTVA FROM (SELECT T.IdProdus, T.Denumire, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, Sum(T.SumOfCant) AS SCant, ProduseP.PUTVA FROM Produse INNER JOIN ((SELECT ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire, Sum(Intrari.Cant) AS SumOfCant FROM Produse INNER JOIN ((ProduseP INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON ProduseP.IdProdus = tmpSFP.CodProdus) INNER JOIN ((Furnizori INNER JOIN NIR ON Furnizori.IDF = NIR.IDF) INNER JOIN Intrari ON NIR.IdIntrare = Intrari.IdIntrare) ON ProduseP.IdProdus = Intrari.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID WHERE (((NIR.Data) Between [forms]![sfp]![di] And [forms]![sfp]![dsf]) AND ((tmpSFP.S)=True)) GROUP BY ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire UNION ALL SELECT ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire, -1* Sum(IntrariStorno.Cant) AS SumOfCant FROM (Produse INNER JOIN ((Furnizori INNER JOIN (NIR INNER JOIN IntrariStorno ON NIR.IdIntrare = IntrariStorno.IdIntrare) ON Furnizori.IDF = NIR.IDF) INNER JOIN ProduseP ON IntrariStorno.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON ProduseP.IdProdus = tmpSFP.CodProdus WHERE NIR.Data Between [forms]![sfp]![di] And [forms]![sfp]![dsf] AND tmpSFP.S =True GROUP BY ProduseP.IdProdus, Furnizori.Denumire) AS T INNER JOIN ProduseP ON T.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID GROUP BY T.IdProdus, T.Denumire, Produse.DenumireP, Produse.UM, ProduseP.PUTVA HAVING (((Sum(T.SumOfCant))<>0))) AS X GROUP BY X.Denumire, X.DenumireP, X.UM ORDER BY X.DenumireP;

name: Situatie_Intrari
caption: Situație anuală intrări
rs: SELECT Masini.Masina, Masini.IdMasina, Produse.denumirep AS DenumireProdus, Produse.UM, Sum(Intrari.Cant) AS Cant, Sum(Intrari.ValoareCUTVA) AS ValoareCUTVA FROM ((Masini INNER JOIN Produse ON Masini.IdMasina = Produse.IdMasina) INNER JOIN (Intrari INNER JOIN ProduseP ON Intrari.IdProdus = ProduseP.IdProdus) ON Produse.ID = ProduseP.ID) INNER JOIN tmpSFP ON Intrari.IdProdus = tmpSFP.CodProdus WHERE (((tmpSFP.S)=True)) GROUP BY Masini.Masina, Masini.IdMasina, Produse.denumirep, Produse.UM ORDER BY Produse.denumirep;
